//ConnectionStrings: Local development default, matching docker-compose.yml. Production supplies its own through ConnectionStrings__Postgres in the environment.

Scraping.//AllowLoopbackHosts: Must stay false. Override with Scraping__AllowLoopbackHosts=true only to crawl a local fixture server.
Scraping.//ParserVersion: The parser generation this build produces. Raise it after changing the normalizer or mapper, then run `promote --repromote` to re-transform the staged corpus without re-crawling. Keep it in step with the code: a deploy that stamps rows with a lower number than the parser it actually ran makes the next --repromote either a surprise or a no-op. 2 = ingredient units, 3 = cuisine names, 4 = tag metadata dropped.
